entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Pakistan Movement and Creation, a transformative movement in Pakistan (1930–1947). Emerged from Muslim League and All-India Muslim League founded at Dhaka. Catalyzed Lahore Resolution — Muslim League formally demands the creation of Pakistan and Muhammad Ali Jinnah (Quaid-e-Azam) dies just 13 months after independence.
